rationale: The agent correctly upgraded the dependency and fixed the initial jwt.Sign type mismatch, but then inserted a large block of unstructured commentary directly into the source file, breaking the function declaration. The verifier reports a syntax error at crypto/jwx.go:206:2, which corresponds to the injected text outside any function body. This is a concrete compiler diagnostic that prevents the build from succeeding.
